subject: MarketLane pilot runway and pricing buckets — post-call recap & next steps
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Chen <elliot.chen@marketlane.com>, Sara Lyle <sara.lyle@marketlane.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MarketLane pilot runway and pricing buckets — post-call recap & next steps

Thanks again for the productive call today — appreciate the clear runway and the team context. Short recap and suggested next steps so we stay aligned.

Quick recap of what we heard:
- Primary use case: conversational product search + context-aware summarization for the product detail page.
- Initial integration: embedding+rerank for search; LLM for short-form summaries (avg. 50–80 tokens).
- Expected ramp: pilot week 1 = 250–350k tokens/day, ramping to ~1.1M tokens/day steady state after 2–3 weeks.
- Success criteria: P50 latency < 400ms, rerank accuracy improvement >= +8% (A/B), and pilot ROI signal (>$25k incremental ARR pipeline).

Cost & pricing notes (initial qualification):
- Baseline ask from your side: target unit economics around $25–35 per 1M tokens for the pilot window.
- Using the volumes above, ballpark pilot burn for 30 days at steady state (~1M tokens/day) ≈ 30M tokens ~ target spend at $30/1M ≈ $900. Wait, that's not right — typo; correct calc below.

Let me be explicit with numbers so we avoid confusion:
- Pilot steady-state estimate: 1.1M tokens/day × 30 days ≈ 33M tokens/month.
- At $30 per 1M tokens ⇒ 33 × $30 = $990. (This is per-month inference cost under hosted plan; if you run multiple model variants or long contexts it increases.)
- If you need dedicated throughput or lower unit cost, we can provide dedicated pricing bands (example: $28/1M tokens committed at 3-month minimum + reserved capacity).

Pilot credits & ask:
- We're prepared to offer $12,500 in pilot credits to cover early ramp and edge-case testing (includes higher-than-expected bursts).
- We can extend the trial window by ~45 days if you need more time for integration validation — requires a short MA (mutual action plan) sign-off.

Next technical steps I propose:
1) You send a small sample of expected daily traffic (CSV) — I attached a sample named usage_sample.csv to show format.
2) We schedule an infra sync with your ML infra + our SRE to validate P50/P95 expectations (45–60 min).
3) Ben (cc) will outline credit mechanics + simple SOW for the pilot (SOW_draft.pdf attached).

If that all looks ok I can lock the $12.5k credit and a 45-day extension once you confirm the traffic sample. Would you prefer the SRE sync Tues or Wed next week?

Thanks —
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
[Attachment: usage_sample.csv (CSV, 18KB)]
[Attachment: SOW_draft.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]

From: Elliot Chen <elliot.chen@marketlane.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lyle <sara.lyle@marketlane.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MarketLane pilot runway and pricing buckets — post-call recap & next steps

Thanks Mina — quick clarifications/questions from our side after reviewing with infra and product: 

1) Volumes: the 1.1M tokens/day is our steady-state projection for the core search rerank traffic only. We will have an additional explorer funnel that might add 200–300k tokens/day during peak. For pilot planning, please size for up to 1.4M tokens/day worst-case.

2) Token mix: avg token per request varies by flow — rerank requests are ~40–60 tokens, summaries ~65–90 tokens. The CSV we’ll send will include two rows (rerank + summary) to match your sample.

3) Budget & credits: appreciate the $12.5k credit offer — can you confirm the credits expire after the extended trial window? We’d like a 60-day trial total (we onboard mid-April on our calendar).

4) Pricing ask: can you provide a concrete hosted price at the $/1M tokens level for the model variant we discussed (Llama-2-70B quantized) and separately for a smaller 13B family? We need both to price internal cost.

If you can confirm credits timeline and give the $/1M for both model classes, we’ll share the CSV and lock the SRE slot. Preferred SRE slot: Wed 14 Apr 2027 (afternoon PT).

—Elliot
Elliot Chen
Head of ML, MarketLane
elliot.chen@marketlane.com | +1 (206) 555-0199

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Chen <elliot.chen@marketlane.com>, Sara Lyle <sara.lyle@marketlane.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MarketLane pilot runway and pricing buckets — post-call recap & next steps

On Mon, Mar 29, 2027 at 09:03 AM Elliot Chen <elliot.chen@marketlane.com> wrote:
> Thanks Mina — quick clarifications/questions from our side after reviewing with infra and product: 
> 
> 1) Volumes: the 1.1M tokens/day is our steady-state projection for the core search rerank traffic only. We will have an additional explorer funnel that might add 200–300k tokens/day during peak. For pilot planning, please size for up to 1.4M tokens/day worst-case.

Thanks for the clarifications — that worst-case of 1.4M/day is helpful. Responses inline and confirmations below.

Credits & trial window:
- We can make the $12,500 credit valid for 60 days from activation (we’ll start the clock on first production token usage). That gives you the 60-day trial you requested.

Hosted price guidance (ballpark; final depends on exact model and context window):
- Llama-2-70B (8-bit quantized-ish runtime): $38 per 1M tokens (hosted).
- 13B family (optimized): $24 per 1M tokens (hosted).
- Dedicated commit bands (example): $28/1M tokens (70B workload) with a 3-month reserved commit; $18/1M tokens (13B) with commit.

How that maps to your worst-case: 1.4M tokens/day × 60 days ≈ 84M tokens.
- At $38/1M → 84 × $38 ≈ $3,192.
- Pilot credit $12,500 comfortably covers the pilot and allows for extra burst/testing across 2–3 model variants.

Next steps (operational):
1) I’ll lock the $12,500 credit and 60-day window once you confirm you want to activate on first production token.
2) Please send the CSV with the two rows (rerank + summary) and we’ll run a small throughput simulation ahead of the SRE call.
3) SRE sync: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 afternoon PT works — propose 2:00pm PT. Grace (cc) will run the scheduling.
4) Ben will follow up with a short DocuSign-friendly SOW that reflects the credit and optional dedicated path.

I attached an updated SOW_draft.pdf with the explicit credit line and the activation clause.

If that all looks good, confirm the 2pm PT slot and I’ll get the credit locked.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW_draft.pdf (PDF, 43KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Mina — confirmed on credits.
- $12,500 pilot credit (60-day window from first production token).
- If they choose to move to Dedicated within 90 days we can apply a one-time conversion credit of up to $3,000 toward the first commit month.

Action items for us:
- Grace: lock 2pm PT on 14 Apr for SRE sync and send invite to Elliot.
- Mina: once Elliot sends CSV, run the throughput sim and attach results to HS-7654321.
- I’ll prepare DocuSign-ready SOW and include the conversion credit clause.
